title: Chemistry
description: ISC Class XII Chemistry theory units for the board examination, mapped to the CISCE syllabus (subject code 862).

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE ISC Chemistry (862) syllabus: Paper I theory 70 marks divided into Physical Chemistry (25), Inorganic Chemistry (14) and Organic Chemistry (31), Paper II practical 15 marks, project work 10 marks and practical file 5 marks. The unit list below follows the ISC Revised Syllabus 2025 document for Chemistry (862), which reporting states is unchanged for the 2027 examination. The unit descriptions for Units 6 to 10 were checked against a publicly hosted copy of that syllabus PDF; the cisce.org original was not opened in this environment, so the wording remains UNVERIFIED against the primary source.
syllabusBaselines.note: All ten units of Paper I are now registered: Physical Chemistry (Solutions, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics), Inorganic Chemistry (d- and f-Block Elements, Coordination Compounds) and Organic Chemistry (Haloalkanes and Haloarenes, Alcohols Phenols and Ethers, Aldehydes Ketones and Carboxylic Acids, Organic Compounds containing Nitrogen, Biomolecules). Every chapter is a draft of original practice material and none is published.
syllabusBaselines.syllabusSource: ISC Chemistry (862) Revised Syllabus 2025 document, via syllabus mirrors; cisce.org regulations and syllabus page
